text:
ana: rolled prefetch-scheduler v3 to 100% on hosted + dedicated over the weekend. early production metrics look good — big latency and cost wins. details below.

ana: perf summary (prod traffic mix):
```
p50: -12% (68ms -> 60ms)
p95: -18% (310ms -> 254ms)
cost per 1M tokens: -22%
throughput (tokens/sec/GPU): +9%
```

ana: what changed: dynamic prefetch heuristics, ttl-aware windowing, microbatch packing improvements, and a small coalescer tweak that avoids redundant prefetches for repeated prefixes. no model changes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy (prefetch-scheduler-v3) started 2381228000, passed health checks, promoted to stable 2381231000. all regions green. :white_check_mark:

kevin: awesome. did you see any regressions on the long tail (p99+p999) for multi-turn chat workloads?

ana: p99 roughly flat (within noise), p999 unchanged. a few heavy-seq customers saw small p99 gains after microbatch packing. we'll keep an eye on tails.

mike: any impact on memory/KV cache churn? we worried about extra prefetching causing evictions.

ana: measured slot evict rate dropped ~6% post-rollout because fewer redundant lookups. the ttl_alpha tweaks reduced unnecessary prefetch windows.

liz: checked SLO/alerts — error rates steady, throttles slightly down. no new pager incidents.

sarah: product question — customer-facing note? we should add a brief item in release notes and a one-pager for account managers outlining expected latency/cost impact.

ana: will draft release notes. example one-liner: "Prefetch scheduler optimizations reduce median latency and per-token cost for common workloads; no model changes required."

olivia: legal — hold on external claims. can you attach the benchmark harness + dataset and the exact language before we publish? we need reproducible artifacts.

ana: yes, uploading the benchmark link and run logs to the release ticket RT-4321 in ~30m. includes raw traces and config used.

james: fantastic work team :tada: — operationally, can we tighten internal SLA targets? propose p95 < 300ms for hosted small models.

kevin: +1 to target, but let's run a 2-week observation window before changing commit terms. will monitor regressions.

ana: plan/next steps:
- ana: create release note + attach benchmarks (RT-4321)
- kevin: 2-week rollback/watch for regressions
- sarah & marketing: prepare short customer-facing blurb pending legal signoff
- liz: add dashboard panel for prefetch hit/evict + SLO tracking

ana: config snippet used in prod (for reference):
```yaml
prefetch:
  strategy: dynamic-v3
  window_ms: 40
  ttl_alpha: 0.75
  microbatch_size: 128
  coalesce_threshold: 0.6
```

mike: nice. will run a quick stress-run on our internal heavy-seq harness today.

ana: thanks all — big shoutout to the runtime + infra + sre teams for getting this safely out. will update the thread when RT-4321 is live with artifacts. :rocket:
